article.body:
Preliminary paper benchmarks power use of locally deployed LLMs on consumer GPUs

A preliminary quantitative benchmark of GPU power use for locally deployed large language models on consumer hardware was published on 28 September 2026; it is a measurement study, not a pilot or production operation. The measured process is local LLM inference on consumer GPUs, with electrical power as the reported physical variable. The supplied record provides no verified throughput, energy-per-inference figure, model configuration, GPU count, or production capacity. It therefore does not establish the bottleneck governing scale, whether GPU power draw, compute throughput, memory, thermal management, or another physical constraint.
